explication: Spline captures execution plans and events from data-processing producers, stores them in ArangoDB, and exposes lineage and related metadata through consumer APIs. Producers can submit through REST or Kafka; both paths map versioned payloads into the producer model and persist them. Consumer endpoints retrieve plans and operation details, while the Foxx service provides database-side storage and lineage/impact capabilities. The admin CLI manages database setup, schema migration, retention, and Foxx installation. Several subsystem links are documented by the source index; unsampled runtime wiring is marked dashed and unevidenced.
